networks.name: receipts_desk
networks.description: Paste text with sources; I check every quoted citation against the page it cites.
sample_queries: Check this: Wikipedia says "PostgreSQL, also known as Postgres, is a free and open-source relational database management system" (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PostgreSQL).
My draft cites https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Python_(programming_language) for "Python was invented by Linus Torvalds in 1985". Is that real?
How many of the receipts on this page were rejected, and why?
Rewrite my essay so the citations pass.

peer_policy.note: Local agents and page-local actions only. Other agents can use the public MCP server at ./mcp.

agent_mcp.reason: The agent network runs in the visitor's browser. The site's own tools are a public MCP server at ./mcp (verify_quote, get_receipt).
